description: This file defines the GaugesGrid class which is responsible for creating and managing a grid layout of GUI widgets within a Java Swing application. It provides methods to initialize a grid of given size and to update its layout.

classes.name: GaugesGrid
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a JPanel with a grid layout, allowing for easy setup and reconfiguration of the grid structure.

methods.name: GaugesGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a grid layout configured for the specified number of rows and columns.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Updates the layout of the panel to a new grid size and clears existing components.
